summary_en: ROE target 8%+ (medium-term); DOE (dividend payout ratio on shareholder equity) adopted to stabilize shareholder returns; current ROE 5%+ but below 8% investor expectation; PBR 0.54x; ROIC and WACC both remain below cost of capital; FY3/26 stock price 2,081 yen.
title_en: Notice Regarding Measures to Realise Management with Awareness of Cost of Capital and Stock Price
translation_en_brief: Toyo Logistics updated its capital-cost and stock-price awareness strategy on 10 August 2026 following TSE guidance. The company's board approved revisions to prior targets announced 11 November 2025, incorporating FY3/26 results. The filing shows the group has failed to exceed its cost of capital in either ROE-vs-cost-of-equity or ROIC-vs-WACC comparisons over the period FY3/22–FY3/26. PBR remained below 1.0x (FY3/26: 0.54x); current ROE of 5%+ falls short of the 8% level that investors typically expect. The company now targets ROE exceeding 8% over the medium term through aggressive sales activity, overseas network expansion, asset investment, and DX-driven service quality and cost improvements. Newly adopted is a DOE (dividend payout ratio on shareholder equity) floor to provide stable and predictable shareholder returns across business cycles. The filing itemises four operational initiatives: deepening existing customer relationships and acquiring new customers; expanding global end-to-end logistics via strengthened forwarding; leveraging logistics hub advantages in Chubu and Kanto regions to target growth industries; and expanding final-mile distribution capacity. No share buyback, dividend amount change, or specific capital-allocation programme is announced in this update.
